verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents a versioned API (v3), OAuth 2.0 auth, rate limits, and a downloadable OpenAPI spec, but there is no evidence of a documented version-deprecation policy, sunset timeline, or changelog governing how v3 will be retired or migrated. missing for 10: explicit deprecation/sunset policy, versioning changelog, migration guides between API versions, and any stated support-lifecycle commitments.
